The '''Ruins of Tapoyauik''' is a [[dungeon]] located under the [[Tower of Ascension]] in [[Varlamore]]. They are visited during the quest [[The Heart of Darkness]], after completion of which the ruins become populated with a variety of monsters, all of which are susceptible to [[fire spells]]. Prior to quest completion, they are not accessible.

{{Map|mtype=rectangle|width=250|height=250|align=left|caption=Entrance to the dungeon|rectX=5|rectY=7|x:1693.5,y:3232}}

Pulling the [[Chain (Ruins of Tapoyauik)|chain]] on the bottom floor allows the player to freely climb up and down the chain, without having to navigate the agility obstacles. Additionally, a [[Lift Platform|lift platform]] is available on the ground floor of the [[Tower of Ascension]], which brings the player to the bottom floor of the dungeon, where [[Amoxliatl]] is.

The [[moon key]] can be used on the [[Chest (moon key)|chest]] located on the bottom floor of the ruins for various rewards. 

A [[Dwarven multicannon]] cannot be placed inside the ruins.

==History==
Tapoyauik was originally a fortress built by the [[Old Ones]] before their demise (which the [[Twilight Emissaries]] believe was due to the last cycle of Ximoua).{{CiteNPC|npc=Forebearer Fides|quote=This temple was built atop Tapoyauik, a ruined fortress of the Old Ones. They walked the world during the last cycle, and when the time came for their cycle to end, they embraced their destiny willingly.}} The [[Twilight Temple]] was later built on top of the ruins of the fortress, during the reign of [[Imafore Tullus|Emperor Imafore]]. 

The Twilight Temple was seen as blasphemous by the people of [[Varlamore]] and thus was abandoned for many years.{{CiteNPC|npc=Prince Itzla Arkan|quote=The temple here was built not long before the War of Betrayal. It is said that Imafore wanted somewhere dedicated to Ranul that would rival the Teomat.{{nbsp}}[...] Anyway, the temple was considered an affront to both the Church of Ralos and the Sect of Ranul. After Imafore died, most people were more than happy to see it abandoned.}} Eventually, [[Metzli]] was drawn to the temple due to its position atop Tapoyauik.{{CiteNPC|npc=Forebearer Fides|quote=After the Augur was blessed with glorious purpose, she felt a calling to this place. She came to this fallen temple and built us a home. However, it was not the temple that called to her, but what lies below.}} She formed the [[Twilight Emissaries]] and brought her followers to the Temple to begin excavating the Ruins of Tapoyauik.

==Transportation==
Transport routes to the ruins include:
*The [[Pendant of Ates]] can teleport directly to the Twilight Temple, near the lift.
*[[Quetzal Transport System]] to [[Salvager Overlook]] (requires the [[Landing site]] to be built) and run South towards the Twilight Temple.
*[[Quetzal Transport System]] to [[Quetzacalli Gorge]] (unlocked by default) and run North-East through the gate followed by a turn to the South around [[The Proudspire]] mountain.

The lift platform at the [[Tower of Ascension]] can then be used as a shortcut after completion of [[The Heart of Darkness]] quest, which will bring you to the centre of the slayer area part of the dungeon.

==Monsters==
[[File:Ruins of Tapoyauik - bottom level.png|thumb|align=right|The bottom level of the ruins, where some more difficult monsters can be found.]]
[[File:Ruins of Tapoyauik - Amoxliatl's chamber entrance.png|thumb|align=right|The door to Amoxliatl's lair, found at the west end of the bottom floor.]]
All monsters within the ruins drop [[frozen tear]]s, which are used to charge the [[Pendant of Ates]], as well as the [[Tooth half of key (moon key)|tooth half]] of the [[moon key]].
*[[Cave crawler#Icy|Cave crawler]], post-quest, top floor
*[[Frost crab]], middle and bottom floor
*[[Ice warrior#Varlamore|Ice warrior]], post-quest, middle and bottom floor
*[[Icefiend]], bottom floor
*[[Frost nagua]], top and bottom floor during quest, only on bottom floor post-quest.
*[[Ice giant#Varlamore 1|Ice giant]], bottom floor
*[[Ice spider#Ruins of Tapoyauik|Ice spider]], bottom floor
*[[Chilled jelly]], bottom floor, north-east from lift platform
*[[Brutal blue dragon#Ruins of Tapoyauik|Brutal blue dragon]], on south end of the bottom floor
*[[Blue dragon#Ruins of Tapoyauik|Blue dragon]], bottom floor
*[[Baby blue dragon#Ruins_of_Tapoyauik|Baby blue dragon]], bottom floor
*[[Amoxliatl]], behind the very imposing door on the bottom level, past the frost nagua

==Hunter==
*3 [[moonlight moth]]s around the frost nagua.

==Item spawns==
*Many [[blue dragon scale]]s, scattered about the dragon spawns.

==Mining==
*Two [[runite rocks]] on the bottom floor, north west corner. The rocks are only partially protected from the nearby ice giants; if attacked, manoeuvre the ice giant to the east of the stalagmites.
